content: Yesu Alongesa ha Kutsiha vulo
Kaha uahumine kuje nakuya kucihela ca ku Yundeya na kutuvakana Yondao, kaha vivunga via kungulukile kuli ikeye naua, kaha naua, kuya ku kapandi kendi, uavalongesele.
Kaha Vafaliseo vezile nakumueseka kaha vamuihuile nguavo, “Capua lishiko yala kulukulula mpuevo yendi?”
Kaha uavakumbuilile nguendi, “Mosesa ua mishikile vati?”
Kaha vahandekele nguavo, “Mosesa uatavesele yala kusoneka mukanda uakulukula, nakumulekesa linga aye kuimbo liavo.”
Vuno honi Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Hakukola ca mitima yeni mukemo muasonekelele eli lishiko.
Vuno honi hume hakuputuka ca kutanga, ‘Njambi uatangele yala na mpuevo.’
Omuo ha cuma eci yala akaseza ishe na naye na kukali pandakana na mpuevo yendi,
kaha vaje vavali vakapua muvila umo.
Kaha cije Njambi napandakana, naumo uahi napande kucizitula.”
Kaha omo vakele mu njivo vandongisi va Yesu vamuihuile naua a cimpande eci.
Kaha uahandekele nguendi, “Uoshe alukulula mpuevo yendi nakuambata ueka, alinga vupangala,
kaha nga mpuevo alukulula yaliendi nakukashomboka kuueka, kaha nalingi vupangala.”
Yesu avezikisa vanike vomo vavandende
Kaha vakele nakuneha vanike kuli Yesu, linga a vakuate kaha vandongisi vendi vavatenukilile.
Kaha omo Yesu uacimuene ualuvalele, kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Eceni vanike vavandende veje kuli yange, keti muvavindike, omuo vumuene vua Njambi vunapu vuavo.
Cilivene, njihandeka kuli yeni, uoshe katambula vumuene vua Njambi ngue kanike uamundende ka kavukovela.”
Kaha uavambatele mu mavoko endi na kuvavezikisa, nakuvakambeka mavoko endi hali vakevo.
Yala uakufuka

Kaha omo Yesu uakele nakuya mu vungenzi vuendi, yala uashatukile na kuija na kutsikama mavuli kuli ikeye, na kumuihula nguendi, “Mulongisi uacili, njilinge vati linga njikasuane vumuene vua muono ua yaye?”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Vika unjitumbuila nguove njiuacili? Naumo uahi uacili kuvanga Njambi lika liendi.
Uatantekeya mashiko, ‘Keti utsihe, Keti ulinge vupangala, Keti uive, Keti uhane vukaleho vua makuli, Keti ukuise, Singimika isho na vanoko.’”
Kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Mulongisi, vioshe evi njaviniungu hume ku vuanike vuange.”
Kaha Yesu omo uamutalele kaha uamuzangele, kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Uahono cuma cimo, ya, ukalandese viuli navio, uhane vihutu, kaha ukapua na vufuko muilu, kaha ija, linga unjikave.”
Omuo uevuile evi uakotamesele cihanga cendi, kaha uaile na vusiua, omuo uakele navufuko vuavuingi.
Kaha Yesu uatalele talele, kaha uahandekele kuli vandongisi vendi nguendi, “Capua cacikalu kuli vaje vakakufuka kukovela mu vumuene vua Njambi!”
Kaha vandongisi vendi vakomokele ha mezi endi. Vuno honi Yesu uahandekele kui vakevo naua nguendi, “Vanike, cacikalu vati kukovela mu vumuene vua Njambi!
Cacasi kamelu kukovela mulisho lia nguya kupulakana mukakufuka kukovela mu vumuene vua Njambi.”
Kaha valikomokele cikuma, kaha vahandekele kuli vakevo nguavo, “Iya honi vakamusambesa?”
Yesu uavatalele kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Ku vantu cacikalu, vononi keti kuli Njambi, omuo viuma vioshe viaviasi kuli Njambi.”
Petulu uaputukile kuhandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Tala, tuaseze viuma vioshe nakukukava.”

Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Cilivene,” njimileka nguange, “naumo uahi naseze njivo cipue vandumbueni cipue vamuanetu cipue vaina cipue vaishe cipue vanike na mavu, natuyando, omuo yange na muzimbu uacili,
iya kakatambula cihita muntsimbu ino, vinjivo navandumbu na vamuanetu na vananetu na vanike na mavu, na tuyando, na mu miaka ikeja ya muono ua yaye.
Vuno honi vavengi vaje vali kulutue va kapua kunima, kaha vakunima vakapua kulutue.”
Yesu Ahandeka Ntsimbu ya Mucitatu ha Kutsa cendi

Kaha vakele nakuya mungila, kukanduka ku Yelusalema, kaha Yesu uakele na kuvatuamenena kulutue, kaha vakomokele, navaje vamukavele vovuile liova. Kaha vambatele naua vaje likumi na vavali, uaputukile kuvaleka vije vikalingiua kuli ikeye.

Nguendi, “Taleni, tulinakukanduka ku Yelusalema, kaha muna Njambi vakamuhana kuli vakuluntu va tutasesondote na valongisi va mashiko kaha vakamuhisa nakumutuala kukutsa, nakumuhana kuli vaje keti vaje Vayunda,
kaha vakamushendumuna, na kumujekuila malanzi, nakumupupa, nakumutsiha kaha hanima ya matangua atatu akasanguka.”
Cihula ca Tiango na Iuano
Kaha Tiango na Iuano, vana va Zembendeo, vezile kuli ikeye, kaha vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Mulongisi, tutonda utulingile vioshe tutonda kuli yove.”
Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Vika vimutonda kuli yange kumilingila?”
Kaha vahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Tutavese linga tutumame, umo ku livoko liove liacilio mukuavo kulia cimoshue, mu vumpau.”
Vuno honi Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Kumuatantekeyele vimuhulisa. Muhasa kunua nganja ije njinua, cipue kumimbuitika mu cimbuitikilo civanjimbuitikile naco?”
Kaha vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Tuhasa.” Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Nganja ije njinua neni mukainua, na cimbuitikilo ci vananjimbuitika naco, cikeco vakamimbuitika naco,
vuno honi kutumama ku livoko liange lia cilio cipue lia cimuoshe keti yange kutava, vuno honi viavaje vanavuaheselele.”
Kaha omo vaje vandongisi likumi vevuile eci, valuvalelele Tiango na Iuano.

Kaha Yesu ua vasanene vaije kuli ikeye kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Muatantekeya ngueni vaje vanapandele kuyula vaje keti Vayunda valiyongola nguavo vali na nzili hali vantu vavo, kaha naua vantuama vavo vali na nzili yakama hali vakevo.
Vuno honi ku cikafu ngoco hhakati keni, vuno honi uoshe atonda mukuluntu hhakati keni napande kupua ndungo yeni muvoshe.
Kaha naua uoshe atonda kupua ua kulivanga hhakati keni napande kupua ndungo ua voshe.
Omuo Muna Muntu kezile mukumupangela vuno honi mukupanga, nakuhana muono uendi linga apatule vantu vavengi.”
Yesu atonesa mesho a kapuputua Mbatimeo
Kaha vahetele ku Yeliko, kaha omo uakele nakuhuma mu Yeliko na vandongisi vendi na civunga cakama ca vantu, Mbatimeo, uje kapuputua mukakulomba, muna Timeo, uatumamene kumukulo ua ngila.
Kaha omo vovuile nguavo Yesu uaku Nazaleta, uaputukile kutambeka nguendi, “Yesu Muna Ndaviti, njivuileko ngozi!”
Kaha vantu vavengi vamuvindikile, vamulekele nguavo aholoke, vuno honi uatambekele cikuma nguendi, “Muna Ndaviti, njivuileko ngozi!”
Kaha Yesu uemanene kaha uahandekele nguendi, “Musaneni.” Kaha vasanene uje kapuputua, kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Kuata mutima, katuka, alinakukusana.”
Kaha uombilile vuzalo vuendi kaha uemanene nakuya kuli Yesu.
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Vika utonda kuli yange linga njikulingile?” Kaha uje yala uakapuputua uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Muene, njitonda njimone.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Ya, lutsilielo luove lua kukanguisa.” Kaha hajevene uatonene kaha uaputukile na kumukava.
